title: Marriage of Female Heirs

questions.question: Who brought a problem regarding Zelophehad's daughters to Moses?
options: The heads of the fathers' houses of the clan of the people of Gilead (Manasseh)
questions.correctAnswer: The heads of the fathers' houses of the clan of the people of Gilead (Manasseh)
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:1 (ESV): "The heads... of the clan of the people of Gilead... came near and spoke..."

questions.question: What was the concern?
options: If they marry outside the tribe, their inheritance will be taken from the tribe
questions.correctAnswer: If they marry outside the tribe, their inheritance will be taken from the tribe
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:3 (ESV): "And if they are married to any... of another tribe, then their inheritance will be taken..."

questions.question: What did God command regarding Zelophehad's daughters?
options: They may marry whom they think best, but only within the clan of the tribe of their father
questions.correctAnswer: They may marry whom they think best, but only within the clan of the tribe of their father
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:6 (ESV): "Let them marry whom they think best, only they shall marry within the clan of the tribe of their father."

questions.question: Why this rule?
options: So that the inheritance of the people of Israel shall not be transferred from one tribe to another
questions.correctAnswer: So that the inheritance of the people of Israel shall not be transferred from one tribe to another
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:7 (ESV): "The inheritance of the people of Israel shall not be transferred from one tribe to another..."

questions.question: Did the daughters obey?
options: Yes, they married sons of their father's brothers (cousins)
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, they married sons of their father's brothers (cousins)
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:10-11 (ESV): "Zelophehad's daughters did... married sons of their father's brothers."

questions.question: This law applies to whom?
options: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe
questions.correctAnswer: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:8 (ESV): "And every daughter who possesses an inheritance... shall be wife to one of the clan of the tribe of her father..."

questions.question: What happens in the Jubilee if they had married outside?
options: It would be added to the tribe into which they married (permanently lost)
questions.correctAnswer: It would be added to the tribe into which they married (permanently lost)
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:4 (ESV): "And when the jubilee... comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry."

questions.question: Where were these commandments and rules given?
options: In the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho
questions.correctAnswer: In the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:13 (ESV): "...in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho."

questions.question: Who spoke God's command in response?
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:5 (ESV): "And Moses commanded the people of Israel according to the word of the Lord..."

questions.question: This concludes which book?
questions.explanation: This is the last chapter of Numbers.

questions.question: The daughters married into which specific tribe?
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:12 (ESV): "They were married into the clans of the people of Manasseh the son of Joseph..."

questions.question: How many daughters were there again?
What is the key principle of land ownership here?
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:9 (ESV): "So no inheritance shall be transferred from one tribe to another..."

questions.question: Did the inheritance remain with them after marriage?
options: Yes, "and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father's clan"
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, "and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father's clan"
questions.explanation: Numbers 36:12 (ESV): "...and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father's clan."

key_verse_text: The inheritance of the people of Israel shall not be transferred from one tribe to another, for every one of the people of Israel shall hold on to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
